case_title: AXIUS INC. VS. EZ PR LLC

docket_entries.description: ORDER OF EXAMINATION ISSUED AS TO DEFENDANT EZ PR LLC HEARING SET FOR OCT-17-2019 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) COLIN BARCELOUX, CEO FILED BY PLAINTIFF AXIUS INC.
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT EZ PR LLC

SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF OCT-17-2019 IS OFF CALENDAR - JUDGMENT SATISFIED. PLAINTIFF/JUDGMENT CREDITOR AXIUS INC, REPRESENTED BY COLLIN BARCELOUX, CEO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT/JUDGMENT DEBTOR EZ PR LLC, REPRESENTED BY EDWARD ZITRON CEO IS PRESENT. JUDGE ROBERSTON TAKES THE BENCH. DEFENDANT STATES THAT A PRIOR ATTEMPT TO SATISFY THE JUDGMENT WAS MADE TO PLAINTIFF/JUDGMENT CREDITOR BY MAILING A CHECK TO AXIUS INC ON AUGUST 17, 2019, TO THE ADDRESS LISTED WITH THE COURT AND THAT THE MAILED CHECK WAS RETURNED TO THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR DUE TO THE ADDRESS BEING INCORRECT AND THAT UPON FUTHER RESERACH WITH THE SECRETARY OF STATE OF CALIFORNIA, IT IS SHOWN THAT AXIUS INC IS NO LONGER IN BUSINESS. JUDGMENT DEBTOR SHARES HIS CONCERNS WITH THE COURT THAT RE: THE CORRECT OWNERSHIP OF THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR. JUDGMENT CREDITOR STATES IN OPEN COURT THAT EVENTHOUGH THE OWNERSHIP HAS CHANGED, PAYMENT CAN STILL BE MADE TO AXIUS INC. THE COURT DIRECTS THE JUDGEMENT DEBTOR TO PAY THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR WITH A CHECK MADE OUT TO AXIUS INC. JUDGMENT CREDITOR FILES SATISFACTION OF JUDGEMENT WITH THE COURTROOM CLERK. THE COURT ORDERS THAT THE COST BILL AFTER JUDGMENT FILED SEP-05-2019 BE VACATED. JUDGMENT IS SATISFIED IN FULL. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
